title: Plumeform alternating feature rows
description: Feature rows on warm paper: eyebrow, tight bold title and slate copy (optionally a dotted list) in one half, a translucent glass panel floating over blurred mint, sky and peach clouds in the other, sides alternating, with very generous gaps between rows. Copy and panels rise in with a soft blur; the clouds float and drift as you scroll.
notes: each panel is a media slot: the original's live mini-demos are not rebuilt
an optional centred intro line sits above the rows (the original uses it under the hero)
